news.title: No winner for P563.29M jackpot in Nov. 20 lotto draws
PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Lotto 6/42 winner gets P26.9M in November 19, 2026 draw

A bettor from Davao del Sur won the PHP26.9-million jackpot in Thursday night's Lotto 6/42 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office says Friday (Nov. 20, 2026). The winning combination was 15-40-08-34-23-10, earning the bettor PHP26,912,539.06. |
